# Mazala Outdoors — mazala.online
> Premium outdoor equipment distributor in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. Every product is field-tested in Mongolian conditions under the "Mongol Shalguur" standard; each published test documents at least one flaw.

Exclusive Mongolian distributor: Greenstove (pellet/wood stoves), Coody (inflatable tents), Sofirn (lights).
Official distributor: Bereg (UP5 expedition tents, boats), OneTigris, Acebeam, Civivi.
Authorized supplier: Black Ice (down sleeping bags and apparel).

## Key pages
- /en/about: Company, founders, testing methodology (English)
- /en/b2b: Corporate purchasing for mining and field operations (English)
- /camping, /fishing, /hiking: Category hubs (Mongolian)
- /brands/: Brand pages with specs, warranty and FAQ (Mongolian)
- /shalguur/: Published field test reports with documented flaws
- shop.mazala.online: Online store (Mongolian)

Contact: Facebook Messenger (domestic), WhatsApp (international/B2B).
